title: `prompts/list`
description: Lists the prompt templates a server exposes, with their names, titles, descriptions and argument definitions.
question: Can the agent discover the server's prompts?
notes: Both adapters that reach 2026-07-28 expose it; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Discoverable through both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 exposes `list_prompts` returning the raw result; Pydantic AI 2.40.0 exposes `list_prompts` returning adapted `Prompt` objects that keep name, title and description. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Prompts are the user-controlled primitive: the slash commands and menu entries a server contributes to the host. A framework that ignores them silently discards a third of what the server publishes, and the omission is invisible because nothing errors.
